subject: Re: Compliance add-on pricing model (seat vs per-call) and annualized credit proposal
messages:
From: Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@medlink.health>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Cc: legal@medlink.health, cfo@medlink.health
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance add-on pricing — seat vs per-call breakdown

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Legal and finance asked for a concise breakdown of how your compliance add-on is charged. Specifically we need: 1) the difference between charging for KMS/HSM as a per-seat (admin/key-holder) line item vs per-call HSM usage; 2) audit log retention tiers and the incremental cost for 7/30/365 day retention; and 3) whether data residency adds a per-region surcharge or is folded into a single subscription.

We're also interested in a path that gives us predictability: MedLink prefers a committed annual budget rather than variable monthly bills. If Redwood can convert anticipated usage into an annualized credit with a small discount, that could work for procurement. Can you sketch options and an example for our estimated volume (~120M tokens/month, ~1k HSM calls/month, ~350k API calls/day)?

Appreciate a one-page table and a short recommendation.

Best,
Amira Hassan
Head of Product Operations
MedLink Health

---

From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Amira Hassan <amira.hassan@medlink.health>
Cc: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.com>, legal@medlink.health
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance add-on pricing — seat vs per-call breakdown

Amira —

Thanks for the clear ask and the numbers. I attached a brief pricing table (Compliance_Addon_Pricing_v1.pdf) and a retention tier workbook. Summary/high level recommendations below:

- KMS/HSM: we offer two models.
  - Seat-based KMS admin: $2,500 per admin seat/month (recommended if you need managed key ops, dedicated HSM seats, audit trail access for named users).
  - Per-call HSM: $0.015 per HSM operation (suitable if you have low admin footfall and want true usage alignment).

- Audit logs (ingestion + storage + query):
  - 7 days: included for free in base compliance tier.
  - 30 days: +$0.02 per 1k API calls/day equivalent.
  - 365 days: +$0.18 per 1k API calls/day equivalent (includes cold-tier storage and retrieval SLA).

- Data residency: regional residency is a +12% surcharge per region for isolated deployment (covers committed capacity and logging replication). Cross-region routing is available but incurs per-GiB egress.

Proposal for an annualized credit model (designed for procurement predictability):
  - Option A (Committed Credit): MedLink commits to a 12-month $360k compliance credit (applied monthly as a deduction against compliance add-on usage). In return Redwood offers a 15% volume credit bonus (so $360k credit equivalency = $414k list value). This covers audit logs for 365 days and seat-based KMS for up to 3 admin seats. Per-call HSM beyond 1.5k ops/month billed at discounted $0.012/op.
  - Option B (Hybrid): Smaller annual commit $180k + per-call HSM at $0.013/op and audit logs at 30-day tier included.

I've included example arithmetic in the PDF. If you want, we can also present a 36-month amortized spread for CAPEX budgeting.

Next steps: if this looks close, Monica (cc'd) will run discount/executive approval and we can prepare an amendment and DocuSign link.

Cheers,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive — Compliance & Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Compliance_Addon_Pricing_v1.pdf

Looping in legal/ops context for negotiation notes. Quick internal thoughts before we respond:

- For enterprise deals of this size (RDW-84721 trending to ~$1.2M ARR across products) we can be flexible on the credit bonus. Recommend we offer 20% list uplift on the committed credit if they sign a 12-mo amendment with a 10% prepay. Rationale: better cash conversion and predictability.

- Offer structure suggestion:
  1) Base compliance bundle (audit logs 365, residency to US regions) included in credit drawdown.
  2) KMS: include 2 admin seats in base; additional seats $1,800/mo (discounted).
  3) Per-call HSM: tiered pricing breaks at 1k/5k/20k ops with step discounts (we can attach the tier table).

- Negotiation levers to close quickly: DocuSign-ready amendment, single-line invoice for compliance credit, 30-day termination clause on add-on only if they downgrade below the committed credit threshold.

I pushed updated language into Draft_Amendment_MedLink_Redwood.docx (track changes). Priyom — if you want the 20% uplift and 10% prepay, let's mark it in the PDF and I will route for approval. Sergio: confirm if the residency + audit replication is operationally fine for our US West cluster.

-M

Subject: Final offer: annualized compliance credit + amendment (DocuSign)

Amira / Legal —

Thanks for the patience while we ran approvals. Final offer summary below (clean terms attached in the amendment):

- Committed credit: $360,000 for 12 months. Redwood will apply a 20% uplift to list (credit value $432,000) if MedLink: 1) signs the amendment within 14 days and 2) prepays 10% of the committed credit on execution.
- Coverage: audit logs (365 days), US residency, KMS 2 admin seats included.
- Excess HSM ops: first 1.5k ops/month covered; additional ops billed at $0.012/op.
- Add-on termination: compliance add-on may be terminated separately with 30 days' notice only if monthly drawdown is below 25% of the committed credit for three consecutive months.
- Invoicing: single-line invoice for the committed credit with monthly drawdown statements.

I uploaded the amendment to DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/StartInSession.aspx?envelopeId=EXAMPLE-1234. For procurement: if you need a net-45 invoice instead of 10% prepay we can do that but the uplift drops to 15% (we need the prepay to fund HSM seat reservations).

Please let us know if legal wants one small change to the invoicing clause — Monica and I can handle redlines live. If approved, we'll enable the residency deployment and reserve capacity for KMS seats in our US-West cluster.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive — Compliance & Security
Redwood Inference

Attachment: Draft_Amendment_MedLink_Redwood.docx
